modelspec.observatory.TensorOperator.title: TensorOperator
modelspec.observatory.TensorOperator.description: The Tensor IR operations, ReluGrad, BroadcastScalar, EmbeddingGrad, SumRows, GeluGrad, LayerNormGradX, LayerNormGradGamma, SoftmaxGrad, AttentionGradQ, AttentionGradK, AttentionGradV, CrossEntropyGrad and DropoutGrad being internal gradient ops, StopGradient a source op that the pass after autodiff removes so that no training step holds it, and Sqrt and Div internal ops of the optimizer subgraph of an AdamW step (DESIGN.md § 3.1, § 4; `TensorOp` in `modelspec-core/src/ir/tensor.rs`). The operators of epic:bert-from-scratch join as the compiler gains them.
